body:
**What.** Barkdown CI boots Postgres + Phoenix from a pinned Barkpark checkout and runs the parity rows; Barkpark CI runs the same rows on a PR that touches `api/assets/paper-editor`. A row can only go from red to green by a test, and a green row going red blocks the merge.

**Acceptance.** A PR in either repo shows the matrix result; a deliberately broken Tab-in-table fails the Barkpark PR.

**Estimate.** 2 days. **Depends on.** #2, #3.

Part of the plan in docs/PLAN.md; the standing goal is docs/EDITOR-PARITY.md; the sizing is docs/TIPTAP-REVIEW.md.

comments.body: Barkdown side done: .github/workflows/parity.yml boots Postgres + a Barkpark checkout at app/BARKPARK_REF (bp CLI built from it, demo seed, Phoenix on :4000 via app/tests/ci/boot-barkpark.sh) and runs every live row under Xvfb; the fifth run is 17/17 rows green (https://github.com/FRIKKern/barkdown/actions/runs/35548400675), and a red row fails the check. Four rows needed hardening for the runner (programmatic caret placement where a click does not move it; the popup's active row; waiting for the Tab-added row; a ProseMirror clipboard replay). Barkpark side: .github/workflows/barkdown-parity.yml on barkdown/editor-quality runs the same rows on a PR touching api/assets/paper-editor, PortableDoc or the bundle — it needs the BARKDOWN_READ_TOKEN secret (a fine-grained PAT with Contents: read on this private repo) and skips with a warning until it is set. Once the secret exists, the deliberately-broken-Tab check can be run to close this.

Status 2026-10-04. The Barkdown half is done and the Barkpark workflow (`barkdown-parity.yml`) is on Barkpark's main and runs on pull requests, but it has no way to read this private repository, so it skips its rows and reports success. One thing is missing and it needs the owner: a credential that lets Barkpark's CI read Barkdown.

Either of these closes it:

1. A fine-grained personal access token with Contents: read on `FRIKKern/barkdown`, stored as the secret `BARKDOWN_READ_TOKEN` on `FRIKKern/barkpark`.
2. A read-only deploy key on `FRIKKern/barkdown` with its private half as a secret on `FRIKKern/barkpark`, and the workflow switched to check out over SSH. An agent can set this up with `gh` if told to; it was not done unasked because it creates a credential.

After that, the deliberately broken Tab-in-table check from the acceptance can be run.

Why this matters, measured on 2026-10-04: moving Barkdown's pin 526 Barkpark commits forward turned six parity rows red (`docs/cycles/C093-pin-six-headings.md`). Barkpark's pull-request check was meant to catch each of those as it happened, and it has been passing without running the rows because it cannot read this repository. The credential described above is what keeps the next pin move small.
